answer: Make every claim spend standing: each identity holds non-transferable credibility, and each reward claim consumes it like nectar drawn from a comb — once spent, it is gone. Standing refills only through fresh verified work; it cannot be transferred, pooled, or bought. A sybil operator's shells fall to their nadir after a single claim, empty batteries demanding real labor to refill. Minting new shells starts each at zero, so the farm's throughput is bounded by genuine work, not shell count. Shells strike the karst of this economy: terrain where every shortcut collapses into a sinkhole.
